## Recall · Slides and notes

a) Where do the details of a slide go?
b) What does Presenter View show you that the class does not see?
c) About how many seconds does each slide of a three-minute talk get?

::: {.answer}
a) in the speaker notes
b) your notes, the next slide and a timer
c) about 30–40 seconds
:::

## Recall · Four checks

a) A slide says 320 minutes, and Excel says 230 minutes. Which check fails?
b) A slide says "Everyone loves juice." Which check fails?
c) An AI tool wrote the outline, and no slide says so. Which check fails?

::: {.answer}
a) accuracy
b) claims
c) honesty
:::

## Summary

- A short talk has five slides: the title, the question, the chart, the insights and the end.
- Slides from Outline or an AI outline makes them fast; the chart comes from Excel.
- Four checks on every slide: accuracy, claims, pictures and honesty.
- Short speaker notes and one rehearsal with the timer of Presenter View.
- Look at the class, speak slowly, and end with your main insight.
